title.en: SAMPLE: Reviewers shared unpublished papers with an AI chatbot
title.zh: SAMPLE：審稿人把未發表的論文分享給 AI 聊天機器人

found.en: The journal Sample Review found that reviewers pasted the text of 31 unpublished manuscripts into a public AI chatbot to help write their reports.
found.zh: 期刊 Sample Review 發現，審稿人把 31 份未發表稿件的內容貼進公開的 AI 聊天機器人，來協助撰寫審查報告。

matters.en: Authors send unpublished work to a journal in confidence. Pasting it into a public tool breaks that trust and may expose the work.
matters.zh: 作者把尚未發表的成果寄給期刊，期待對方保密。把它貼進公開的工具，就違背了這份信任，也可能使成果外洩。

ai_helped.en: Reviewers used an AI chatbot to help write reports. Sample Review does not name the chatbot.
ai_helped.zh: 審稿人用 AI 聊天機器人協助撰寫報告。Sample Review 沒有說出這個聊天機器人的名稱。

how_sure.en: Checked. Sample Review, the journal involved, says so in its own statement and in an editorial note.
how_sure.zh: 已查核。相關期刊 Sample Review 在自己的聲明和編輯說明中這麼表示。

background.en: Peer review is the step where outside experts judge a paper before it is published.
background.zh: 同儕審查是論文發表前，由外部專家評斷論文的步驟。

could_lead.en: Journals could write clear rules and tell reviewers what they may share.
could_lead.zh: 期刊可能訂出明確的規則，告訴審稿人哪些內容可以分享。

evidence.quote: pasted the text of 31 unpublished manuscripts into a public AI chatbot
